craft pace.median: median shot 6.1 s, target 2–4 s; split the long shots: one short line, one picture (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft pace.p90: 90th percentile shot 8.5 s, target ≤ 6 s; a long hold has to be a designed one; cut to the listener's face or an insert (hook-s001, hook-s002, hook-s003, hook-s004, hook-s005, hook-s006, hook-s007, origin-s008, … 40) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft pace.longest: longest shot 10.2 s, target ≤ 8 s; longer than the shortest clip the pipeline buys (hook-s004, origin-s008, origin-s014, origin-s020, idea-s031, engine-s042, engine-s050, turn-s090, … 9) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft hook.opening: shots that start in the first 10 s 2, target ≥ 4; open inside the event: place, the lead doing something, the lead's face, the other side's reaction (hook-s001, hook-s002) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)
craft hook.opening30: shots that start in the first 30 s 4, target ≥ 10; the opening half-minute is where the density goes (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft hook.dialogue: first line spoken by a character never, target ≤ 10 s; let someone in the scene speak first; a retelling with no speaking characters answers this row in the report (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.median: median line length 21 characters, target ≤ 12; people in a scene speak in short turns; break the sentence where the cut goes (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.long: lines over 20 characters 56%, target ≤ 10%; a line this long holds one picture too long; split it across two shots (hook-s001, hook-s002, hook-s003, hook-s004, hook-s005, hook-s006, hook-s007, origin-s008, … 40) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft lines.narrator: narration and inner voice, share of the spoken text 100%, target ≤ 35%; turn narration into what a character says or does; keep it for time jumps (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft size.face: faces (medium close-up and closer, over-the-shoulder) 25%, target ≥ 40%; the audience follows a face; give each turn of the scene a face that reacts (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft size.insert: inserts 0%, target 5%–25%; an insert answers a story question (which paper, whose hand); too few hides the proof, too many hides the people (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)
craft size.wide: wide and group shots 35%, target 5%–30%; show where everyone stands, briefly, then go back in (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft motion.look: shots where the only behaviour is a look, a breath or a tremor 100%, target ≤ 33%; reaction shots are needed, a third is the ceiling: elsewhere write what the person does to someone or something (hook-s001, hook-s002, hook-s003, hook-s004, hook-s005, hook-s006, hook-s007, origin-s008, … 71) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft motion.run: such shots in a row 71 shots, target ≤ 2; three looks in a row is three portraits: put an action between them (hook-s001, hook-s002, hook-s003, hook-s004, hook-s005, hook-s006, hook-s007, origin-s008, … 71) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft motion.opening: first three shots all looks, target something happens; the opening is an action in progress, not three portraits (hook-s001, hook-s002, hook-s003) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft risk.decorative: shots with nobody in them that are not inserts 41% (29), target ≤ 10%; a place with nobody in it is a postcard: put the person about to act in the frame, or make it an insert that answers a question (hook-s001, hook-s004, hook-s006, origin-s008, origin-s016, origin-s022, idea-s023, idea-s024, … 29) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)

craft risk.text_first: cards (title, chapter, quote …) against the shots 19 of 90 scenes, 22% of the time, target ≤ 2 cards, or ≤ 10% of the time; a drama is told in pictures: say it in a shot, with a line over it (origin-s010, origin-s012, idea-s027, idea-s032, idea-s033, idea-s038, engine-s041, engine-s044, … 19) (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama-craft.md)
